rationale: ITER-3 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX. (1) NUMBERS trajectory: iter-1 naf_hidden=128 -> SSIM 0.4729, hr 0.0, PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08, elapsed 1097s, median ~91 Adam steps/scene (5.0s per-scene wall), 18-min outer wall (1080s) hit EXACTLY at scene 214 (1082.5s). iter-2 naf_hidden=128->64 (cheaper hiddenxhidden matmuls -> more steps/scene) -> SSIM 0.4943, hr 0.0, PSNR 18.62, elapsed 1100s: +0.0215 SSIM, CONFIRMING the budget-starvation diagnosis (cheaper step -> more per-scene optimization -> higher SSIM). Still FAR below the LD-FBP floor (~0.81 cal). (2) FAILURE MODE: budget-starved per-scene INR fit. A NeRF-style coordinate-MLP wants hundreds-to-thousands of Adam steps to leave its water-mu init; ~91 steps/scene at hidden=128 (more at hidden=64) leaves the INR barely off init. iter-2's +0.0215 proves we are still on the starvation slope, NOT yet at the structural floor. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_layers 4->3 (naf_hidden=64, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_lr=1e-2, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). The hidden-width lever was spent in iter-2; the next leanness step is MLP DEPTH. NAF.__init__ builds [Linear(in,h),ReLU] + (layers-2) x [Linear(h,h),ReLU] + Linear(h,1); at layers=4 that is TWO hiddenxhidden blocks, at layers=3 it is ONE -> removing one full 64x64 Linear+ReLU cuts the per-step MLP matmul cost ~1/3 (over 512^2=262144 coords each step) on top of the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward. 214-SCENE 20-MIN BUDGET MATH (measured): train_n=0, the ENTIRE budget is the per-scene fit loop; total = 214 x per_scene_s = 214 x 5.0s = 1070s ~= the 1080s/18-min outer wall, hit exactly at scene 214 (verified both iters). I CANNOT raise per_scene_s (214 x wall already fills the 20-min compute budget). So to buy MORE Adam steps per scene at FIXED 214x1080s total I make each step CHEAPER again: layers 4->3 drops one 64x64 block -> more steps fit in each 5.0s scene within the SAME wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I shrink naf_layers 4->3, I expect SSIM to rise above 0.4943 because the shallower MLP buys more Adam steps per scene, letting the INR move further off its water-mu init within the same per-scene wall (same mechanism that gave iter-2 +0.0215). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stalls at ~0.49 (or drops) despite the extra steps, NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT) AND/OR has lost too much MLP capacity to represent the slice -> document the per-scene-INR ceiling on dense Mayo as a NEGATIVE result (SSIM ~0.5 vs LD-FBP ~0.81). (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min, in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap so the WALL governs, not the iter count), val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
